messages:
Maya Chen: FYI starting a thread to prep the SLA/SLO evidence bundle for Acme renewal — they want 90d uptime + p95 latency target. Sales flagged renewal risk if we can’t show alignment.
Arjun Patel: Quick clarifying Q — are they asking p95 for inference-only or end-to-end request? (frontend + inference)
Maya Chen: Inference-only. Sales included exact ask: p95 <= 250ms over 90d and uptime 99.9%+.
Luis Gomez: From infra side, 90d uptime is fine (we're at 99.95%). p95 slipped to ~320ms last week during batch job overlap.
Priya Singh: I can run an enablement session Wed next week. Need the top 5 slow request traces and a short runner playbook to show them live tuning.
Maya Chen: Linking the dashboard and current graphs: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/acme/slo?range=90d — will attach exported CSVs to the evidence bundle.
Arjun Patel: If we can’t get p95 down to 250ms within the next 7 days, we should surface the credit path. Sales needs a template number to include in the renewal comms.
Luis Gomez: Ops action: opening a ticket for batching config + KV cache warmup: INC-3423. Plan: increase inter-request batching threshold and warm KV cache on deploy.
Priya Singh: For the enablement playbook I need: 1) list of example prompts, 2) sample response sizes, 3) the canary routing policy we'll demo. Can CS populate the prompts?
Maya Chen: I'll export the top 20 real prompts from onboarding logs and drop them in the shared drive by EOD Friday.
Arjun Patel: Draft credit calc for review:

```
credit = max(0, (SLO_target - observed) / SLO_target) * monthly_commitment
Example: if p95 target not met and degraded by X%, credit bands apply per contract.
```

Will refine with legal.
Luis Gomez: Quick technical note: a short-term mitigation is routing small requests to a quantized model variant; will test rollout in staging tonight. If successful, should shave ~50-80ms from p95.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for quantized-variant -> staging (build 2026.3.19-qa)
Maya Chen: Action items recap:
- CS (Maya): evidence bundle + top prompts by Fri
- Eng (Luis/Arjun): try batching/quantized routing and share results in 72h
- Enablement (Priya): prep 45-min session Wed, need artifacts from CS
- Sales: draft credit language (Arjun to share template)
Priya Singh: I’ll also include a short customer-facing checklist for post-session follow-up (1 pager).
Arjun Patel: I'll ping Legal about the credit wording tomorrow morning.
uptime-bot: Alert summary: no recent uptime breaches in 30d. Latency anomaly detected 3d ago — under investigation.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — will update this thread as evidence uploads happen. @Priya @Luis @Arjun :thumbsup:
